question: Odacc-HI!! Odacchi... What did you have for breakfast? Your face has a nice glow to it. Speaking of breakfast, in volume 68 page 106, could Vergo's breakfast have been potato fries...?? Well? straight from the morning, bro

name: KBBQ straight from the morning
